title: How AI is transforming game development
text: Hi, I'm Yeswint, and this video is about what Godot is and why it's a great fit for building games with AI. Not long ago, making a game meant months of writing code by hand, line after line. That's changing, and it's changing fast. Let me show you the tool that's a big part of why.

title: What is Godot? Free open-source 2D and 3D engine
text: So, here's the whole idea in one breath before any of the details. Godot is a tool for anyone with an idea, not just for programmers. It's free. It makes both 2D and 3D games, and it saves everything it makes as plain text. title: The plain-text superpower: Why AI can safely edit Godot files
text: Around inside. One download, both kinds. Now, how you actually build something in it. A Godot game is made of small pieces called nodes, and you snap them together a bit like LEGO bricks. One node is your character. Another is the picture you see on screen. Another plays a sound. You arrange a handful of them into what's called a scene, and that scene becomes your player or your level.

title: Rebuilding games with Claude AI through natural conversation
text: There's no wall of code to get started. When you want something to actually move, you add a short script. The language is called GDScript, and it reads almost like plain English. Godot saves everything you make as plain text, the kind you could open in any notepad. Your scenes, your settings, your scripts, all of it. So, an AI can open your project, actually read it, change it safely, and then show you exactly

What changed line by line. Other big engines seal their work inside a format only that engine can open. An AI can't safely touch that. This is the reason Godot is the fit. And that is exactly what we do here. We take an old game, hand its logic over to Claude Code, and have it rebuild that game in Godot by conversation. You describe what you want, it builds it. You play it, tell it what felt wrong, and it changes it. You are directing the work, not typing it out. So, if you have been waiting until you learn to code, you don't need to be a programmer to start. You need an idea and a tool that lets an AI do the heavy lifting. Godot, free, readable, and built for making games with AI.
